For those stronger senses in Japanese, words like '要求 (youkyuu)' or '請求 (seikyuu)' would be more appropriate. The Japanese gloss stating 'aligns well with the broad meaning of the English lemma 'request'' contradicts the specific 'Core learning sense' provided for English.
